name: Scented Candle
details: Diptyque's classic candle, in the oval-labelled glass the Paris house has poured since 1963. Choose your scent below; each one fills a room in about twenty minutes.
care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

variants.name: Baies
variants.details: Diptyque's best-seller, from the house's herbarium of fruits. A basket of blackcurrants picked that morning, some still on their stems and leaves, cool and tangy, with a few hand-cut roses tucked among them. Bright, green and juicy rather than sweet: a scent that makes a room feel freshly aired.

variants.name: Figuier
variants.details: Not just the fig but the whole tree: an orchard running along a Mediterranean shore, with the summer sun at its height and a warm wind moving through the branches. Green leaves and milky sap meet warm bark and figs just short of ripe. Verdant and sophisticated, never sugary.

variants.name: Roses
variants.details: Rose bushes in May, caught over the course of a morning. At first the petals are still cool from the night and the scent is fresh and dewy; as the sun comes up it opens into a full, bright bloom. Diptyque's most restrained candle, and a pure homage to the flower.

variants.name: Feu de Bois
variants.details: One of the scents the founders made in 1963. Logs slowly giving way in a winter hearth, the fire roaring and throwing shadows on the walls: dense, resinous and smoky, warm rather than sharp. Made for cold nights, long conversations and a quiet glass of something.

variants.name: Tubéreuse
variants.details: A childhood memory of Vietnam's coast, where the sea breeze drifts over fields of tuberose. The flower is famously heady, but here it is made fresh and a little herbal, with soft fruity and creamy facets. Every side of the tuberose, without the heaviness.

variants.name: Ambre
variants.details: Inspired by the idea of amber beads found in an old treasure box. A warm, enveloping blend of balms, spices and precious woods, where vetiver and patchouli meet aniseed, incense, cistus and tonka bean. Like a golden memory, kept safe; made for evenings in.

variants.name: 34 Boulevard Saint Germain
variants.details: Named for the address of Diptyque's first boutique, in the heart of the Latin Quarter, and meant to hold its memory: bohemian, bookish and artistic. Crushed blackcurrant leaves and fresh moss over rose and warm spices, settling into woods and balms. The house's signature, in a candle.

name: Scented Candle
details: Loewe's Tomato Leaves: the green snap of tomato vines just before the fruit ripens, softened by blackcurrant. Poured into the house's ribbed red vessel, which earns its place on the shelf long after the wax is gone.
care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

name: Incense
details: Sarashina, from the incense Aesop made with perfumer Barnabé Fillion and a Kyoto incense atelier. Dry sandalwood first, then sweet cinnamon and clove, settling into warm, earthy spice. 33 sticks, about 30 minutes each, with a pumice holder.
care: Burn on a heat-proof holder in a well-ventilated room, away from anything flammable. Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Scented Candle
details: Le Labo's classic candle, in the house's simple glass with a label that names its scent. Slow, clean burning and made to scent a whole room. Message us for the scents in stock.
care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

name: Absolue Scented Candle
details: From Lancôme's Absolue line, built around the house's Grand Rose Extract: velvety rose, soft white tea and fresh musk, in a gold vessel.
care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

name: Goddess Scented Candle
details: Burberry Goddess for the home: vanilla at every stage, lit up by aromatic lavender, in blush-pink glass sealed with the gold Goddess medallion.
care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

name: The Yulong Scented Candle

care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

details: Givenchy's Accord Particulier: Damascena rose with a honeyed edge, grounded by Haitian vetiver, patchouli and warm ambrox. In glossy black glass.
care: Burn for two to three hours the first time, so the wax melts evenly to the edge. Trim the wick to 5mm before each use. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

name: Incense
details: Incense from Loro Piana's At Home collection, the same quiet luxury as the house's cashmere, for the rooms you live in. Message us for the scent in stock.
care: Burn on a heat-proof holder in a well-ventilated room, away from anything flammable. Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Hourglass Fragrance Diffuser
details: Diptyque's hourglass: turn it over and the fragrance flows slowly from one glass bulb to the other, scenting the room for about an hour each time. Refillable twice. Choose your scent below.
care: Keep upright on a stable surface, away from direct sunlight and heat.

variants.details: February in the South of France, when the hills of Tanneron near Grasse turn gold with mimosa. Small, fluffy blooms with a velvety, slightly honeyed scent: soft, sunny and quietly sweet, never cloying.
